turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for contacting Acme.  How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi! I need to check the status of my account because my subscription was removed and I still want it

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that, but we'll definitely try to get your subscription back up and running

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: may I ask your full name, so that we can get started?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sanya Afzal

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Sanya Afzal.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, Sanya

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: and to verify your information, may I ask for your account ID and the order ID associated with your subscription

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I do not have any of that information

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see.  One moment, allow me to check with my manager to see if I can access your account in a different way

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: thank you

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: okay, sorry about the wait.  Let me see if I can solve this issue from a different angle

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: A subscription was removed from your account, may I ask how you found out about this?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: email

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: A reason of email has been recorded.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I'll check with our IT department.  The email itself might have been a mistake

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Querying the system for an answer ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, according to our systems, no email was actually sent to you by Acme.  We've been having some trouble with scam emails recently, so I'm very glad you brought this to our attention

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: thank you so much

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If you look very closely, you can see that the email about your subscription being cancelled was not from our official marketing team

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: and you're welcome.  Your account appears to be in order, so there's nothing to worry about.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: oh gosh! I just looked at it. it sure isn't

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: thank you for everything

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, they keep getting craftier, but luckily you were vigilant and double-checked

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If you log into your account at any time, you should see your subscription is still active

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would there be anything else that I can help you with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: no thank you

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome.  Have a great day.
